notes.title: Forest Star is now available as a free game on Steam!
notes.notes:
[b]Forest Star[/b] is a short adventure game where you help a monkey find a fallen star. Meet and recruit other animals, find useful items, and discover new abilities. Multiple endings available depending on your choices!

I made [b]Forest Star[/b] in about a month for the "Touch The Stars" game jam during the summer of 2021, where it ended up winning 3rd prize. If you enjoyed [b]The Ghost Cage[/b], you might like [b]Forest Star[/b] as well.

You can get it for free here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823350/Forest_Star/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823350/Forest_Star/[/url]

notes.title: Release of The Ghost Cage, a free game!
notes.notes:
[i][b]The Ghost Cage[/b][/i] is now available as a free game on Steam! This short and light-hearted pixel art adventure game was made in less than a month for the [b]Spooktober Spooktacular Game Jam[/b] last year, where it won 1st prize.

[i][b]The Ghost Cage[/b][/i] is not a horror game, but I decided to release it on Steam now because October seems to be an appropriate month for a game featuring a ghost (though it's not a scary one!), and also as a homage to Oscar Wilde, whose birthday was October 16th. The idea of a ghost whose reaction to you depends on how you treat it and a couple scenes in this game were loosely inspired by Wilde's humorous short story  [i]The Canterville Ghost[/i].

And in conjunction with the release of [i][b]The Ghost Cage[/b][/i], my other game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1327820/The_Lost_Art_of_Innkeeping/]The Lost Art of Innkeeping[/url] is on sale for the next 7 days!
